programs.desc: Remember the Entertainment Book: the chunky voucher book packed with restaurant deals that helped schools and charities raise millions?\nMore than 30 years later the business is still going strong — just a lot more digital.\nThis week we meet Heidi Halson, CEO of The Entertainment Group, the company that transformed that iconic fundraising book into a modern app while continuing to support thousands of charities.
